# Test badge

`geometric-cross.svg` is an original geometric test mask created for Dimple,
with AI assistance. It uses no upstream or Apple artwork and is covered
by the project's [MIT license](../../../LICENSE) (Copyright (c) 2026 efun).

The black cross has a transparent background, a 384 × 384 viewBox, and a
128-pixel grid. Its non-transparent bounds fill the viewBox; corner pixels are
transparent. It contains no text, fonts, scripts, external resources, or embedded
images. This is a rendering fixture, not a product icon or a default folder
template. It is not imported by the application or included in its bundle.
